## STACK
NestJS + TypeORM + Postgres; node24 CJS/ES2023; code=backend/ vault=transaction-analytics/
single-user app: no userId, no roles, no multitenancy

## INVARIANTS (canon Architecture/Invariants.md, verbatim headings)
1. Money is always integers in minor units, never float
2. Dates are UTC in the DB
3. The core does not know about the source
4. Dedup and multi-tenancy
5. Matching is a separate post-processing stage
6. Side effects — only through events
7. Secrets — env/secrets only

## STATUS (canon Roadmap & Status.md)
done  1. DB + entity Transaction + migration | 2. normalize layer + NormalizedTransaction | 3. Monobank provider + sync | 4. Crypto CSV provider | 5. Card↔crypto matching + CryptoPurchase | watermark | Accounts | Single `DATABASE_URL`. | Fix for cross-currency amounts (currency = account currency).
todo  6. Estimate for unmatched (NBU rate) | 7. Bank CSV
